caveats: PAD-US does not tag which easements serve the NCT; any trail-easement reading needs an intersection with the trail corridor, and many trail easements (NCTA, local land trusts, handshake agreements being converted) may not be in it at all.

The Easement class is NCED-derived (non-sensitive easements only); Date_Est is 'not fully attributed'. USGS strongly discourages comparing two PAD-US versions to look for changes in protection status.
Combined-layer records overlap by design (fee + designation + easement on the same ground); the Fee layer is the non-overlapping footprint.
Local park data gaps exist below the state level.
description: USGS Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US) 4.1 — public land ownership and management. Consumed LIVE from the ArcGIS service; no local PAD-US file is downloaded (see site/data/padus-note.md for why: a trail-corridor pull would be thousands of features including very large proclamation-boundary polygons, paginated at 2000 per page, and the whole-line corridor buffer itself could not be built in one shapely pass on this VM).
if_a_local_pull_is_done_later: Query PAD_US_gaz_combined/0 with geometry = the 2 mi corridor buffer as Esri JSON (rebuild the buffer per-state; do not attempt one whole-line shapely union on this VM), geometryType=esriGeometryPolygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outSR=4326, paginated with resultOffset (maxRecordCount 2000). Run a returnCountOnly query first to size it. Clip each returned polygon to the buffer locally, simplify, and keep only FeatClass, Category, Own_Type, Own_Name, Mang_Type, Mang_Name, Unit_Nm, State_Nm, GIS_Acres, Pub_Access, GAP_Sts.
label: Public land (PAD-US)

layers_to_show.note: Show the combined inventory (layers [0] of PAD_US_gaz_combined) as the default public-land overlay. Offer the fee-only layer as the alternative where overlap matters, and the Manager_Name feature layer for click/identify popups.

note: Service URLs and layer choices verified live 2026-11-22 (see site/data/padus-note.md) and re-checked 2026-11-23. Public services, no key required.

combined_raster.description: Combined inventory — fee + designations + easements + marine + proclamation boundaries. Recommended for the viewer as the raster overview (server renders it). Spatial reference WKID 102039 (Albers); the export endpoint reprojects to the map CRS.

fee_raster.description: Fee-simple footprint only (no designations/easements). The non-overlapping footprint — use where the combined layer's overlapping records would double-count. Spatial reference WKID 102100 (Web Mercator).

manager_name_vector.description: ArcGIS Online feature service (same PAD-US 4.1 data, hosted feature layer) — clickable, with popups. Heavier: enable at higher zooms or on demand.

public_access_vector.description: Public access / LLLT feature service (PAD-US 4.1, ArcGIS Online).

source: USGS Gap Analysis Project, PAD-US 4.1 (March 2025), DOI 10.5066/P96WBCHS

wiring.not_recommended: The cached tile service PADUS3_0PublicAccess (https://services.arcgis.com/v01gqwM5QqNysAAi/ArcGIS/rest/services/PADUS3_0PublicAccess/MapServer) is PAD-US 3.0 (2022 vintage) and tiles-only (no attributes) — do not use as primary.
wiring.style_notes: Server renders the raster overlay; no local styling needed. OFF by default (it is a coverage layer, not a trail layer). The viewer already carries this pattern for the ITM government-owned-lands layer (categories Federal / State / Land trust / County / Tribal) — PAD-US replaces that Minnesota-only source nationally.
